notes.title: Keep market-data feeds comparable
notes.source_facts: IEX represents one exchange; SIP consolidates exchange activity.
notes.engineering_inference: Compare volume and spread measurements within a declared feed. A later SIP research series is a separate source-policy partition from the existing IEX series.
notes.limitation: An IEX quote does not establish the Trading 212 execution price.
notes.evidence_needed: Record feed, request, event and receipt times, missing bars and coverage before interpreting changes in setup counts.

notes.title: Check historical access before buying data
notes.source_facts: Alpaca's FAQ permits historical SIP queries with an end at least 15 minutes old without the live subscription; its Paper Only documentation restricts entitlement to IEX.
notes.engineering_inference: A bounded historical request can resolve account-specific access. The current latest-quote refusal does not settle this separate question.
notes.limitation: Historical SIP access on this account is unverified; delayed data cannot substitute for a live entry quote.
notes.evidence_needed: Later probe one completed session, preserve endpoint and response classification, then assess usefulness before discussing a subscription.

notes.title: Freeze adjustments and instrument identity
notes.source_facts: The bars API exposes adjustment and asof options. Split adjustment affects price and volume; asof controls symbol mapping.
notes.engineering_inference: Store the requested ticker, stable identity when available, feed, adjustment mode, asof date and retrieval time. Inspect discontinuities before comparing chart levels.
notes.limitation: Today's backfill need not reproduce the exact history visible at an old decision; a current universe also omits some former listings.
notes.evidence_needed: Later replay both sides of a known split or rename and document universe coverage without changing original case labels.

notes.title: Treat instrument halts separately from market hours
notes.source_facts: Nasdaq's halt RSS covers Nasdaq-listed and other exchange-listed securities. The feed refreshes once per minute and discourages faster polling.
notes.engineering_inference: Add an observed halt/resumption state to the research record, preserving announcement and receipt clocks; require fresh price evidence after resumption.
notes.limitation: A session clock and catalogue match alone do not prove that a particular instrument can trade; the feed can arrive late.
notes.evidence_needed: Later capture normal, halted, stale-feed and resumed scenarios. Keep unknown status explicit rather than treating silence as permission.

notes.title: Use when a filing became available
notes.source_facts: SEC submissions and XBRL APIs require no API key and update as filings are disseminated.
notes.engineering_inference: Separate reporting period, public release or dissemination time, and first scanner receipt. Only information available by the decision cutoff may enter a replay.
notes.limitation: Fast API publication is not a guaranteed scanner receipt time, nor necessarily the earliest company announcement.
notes.evidence_needed: Later retain accession/document links and receipt timestamps; compare company releases with SEC publication where available.

notes.title: Preserve the original filing version
notes.source_facts: SEC provides dated filing archives and company submissions; company-facts data aggregates reported XBRL facts.
notes.engineering_inference: Keep the original document and amendment lineage. Use the version known then, rather than replacing an old decision's facts with a later restatement.
notes.limitation: A currently downloaded aggregate is not proof of the values visible at the historical cutoff.
notes.evidence_needed: Later retain source IDs, file hashes and acquisition times. Use a declared client identity and moderate cached requests under SEC fair-access guidance.

notes.title: Separate an earnings release from an earnings surprise
notes.source_facts: Form 8-K Item 2.02 concerns public announcements of results or financial condition for a completed fiscal period and includes the release text.
notes.engineering_inference: Classify results, guidance and other events separately. An earnings-surprise hypothesis additionally needs a contemporaneous expectation benchmark with matching units and accounting basis.
notes.limitation: The form category alone establishes neither a positive surprise nor a profitable intraday reaction.
notes.evidence_needed: Later match announcement timing with pre-event expectations and fresh market response. If the expectation source is absent, label surprise unknown.

notes.title: Model the delay between alert and execution
notes.source_facts: Alpaca paper simulation omits effects including latency slippage, queue position, market impact and regulatory fees.
notes.engineering_inference: Keep scanner simulation, broker paper fills and existing real fills distinct. Replay declared manual reaction delays using later eligible quotes and expiry rules.
notes.limitation: Order-created to fill time does not reveal when the user saw an alert. A successful paper fill is not a guaranteed live fill.
notes.evidence_needed: Use existing fills where suitable and stress scenarios; no new real-money trade is needed. The user supplies typical alert-response time and availability.

notes.title: Keep Invest and CFD evidence separate
notes.source_facts: Trading 212's public API supports Invest and Stocks ISA, not CFD. API order execution uses the primary account currency and lacks multi-currency support.
notes.engineering_inference: Use the existing Invest mirror for the initial benchmark. Any future CFD experiment needs its own instrument eligibility, prices, spread, financing and position constraints.
notes.limitation: An Invest history import cannot establish CFD execution costs or short availability.
notes.evidence_needed: Retain Invest as the agreed starting scope. Request separate CFD evidence only if the user later chooses that expansion.

notes.title: Retain itemized fill costs and conversion fields
notes.source_facts: Historical orders expose walletImpact.fxRate, itemized taxes/fees and order.initiatedFrom. The app's cost preview is an estimate with assumed holding periods.
notes.engineering_inference: Extend the private import contract to retain those fields, currencies and timestamps, reconcile totals, and avoid subtracting fees twice from net amounts.
notes.limitation: Fields may be absent; fee arrays are not a complete execution-spread measure. Never interpret a missing cost as zero.
notes.evidence_needed: The deployed parser drops fxRate, taxes and initiatedFrom. Inspect bounded private responses and reconcile examples when implementing; no initial Invest CSV request is needed.

notes.title: Distinguish USD display from actual currency conversion
notes.source_facts: Invest permits choosing a trade currency. Trading in the asset currency avoids conversion on that trade; converting funds can still incur an FX fee.
notes.engineering_inference: Infer actual order and wallet currencies before assigning conversion costs. Separate instrument-currency price return, currency movement and explicit charges.
notes.limitation: USD prices on the dashboard do not prove that a USD wallet funded the order. Pre-conversion costs should not also be charged on every subsequent trade.
notes.evidence_needed: Later inspect retained order currency and cost records. Ask the user about wallet routing only if those records leave a material ambiguity.

notes.title: Measure whether confidence matches outcomes
notes.source_facts: Calibration curves compare forecast probabilities with observed event frequencies. Brier and log loss also reflect discrimination and outcome uncertainty.
notes.engineering_inference: Define the event and horizon first, fit any calibration only on earlier data, and evaluate later untouched sessions with stock/session grouping.
notes.limitation: An AI confidence score is not automatically a probability. More reference notes do not create independent outcomes or establish calibration.
notes.evidence_needed: Use a future cohort with closed, unfilled and unresolved outcomes reported separately; retain a simple baseline and uncertainty estimates.

interpretation: Source facts are summarized documentation. Engineering inferences and proposed evidence are our scanner-specific recommendations, not findings of profitable performance. Web pages are mutable and must be rechecked before implementation.
